claims.title: Exact common damping transformation and Duhamel closure
claims.guarantee: a=exp(-kappa*t)b converts common damping to scalar nonlinear weight exp(-2*kappa*t), preserving every initial complex amplitude and phase; no online derivative calls required by the formula.
premises: declared known collective model DW1
positive normalized fixed weights
common real kappa >= 0, real chi, bounded real detunings
limits: not heterogeneous damping or arbitrary local nonlinearity
no existing native damped implementation claimed

claims.title: Uniform-kappa nonlinear homotopy truncation in an exponential-polynomial basis
claims.guarantee: Under DW6 strict ball/contraction conditions, transformed mean coefficients exist uniquely and Q-order truncation has uniform error <= M eta^(-Q-1); each coefficient is finite exponential-polynomial with degree <= (3ell+1)p+ell. For fixed positive margin and bounded detuning horizon p,Q=O(log(1/epsilon)) can be chosen uniformly for every kappa>=0.
premises: eta>1 and M<B
q_eta<1
exact descriptor
interval errors separately charged
full candidate tube verified
limits: scalar exponential/phi bit cost may depend on kappa and conditioning
not a claim of lower cost than original kappa=0 polynomial candidate

exact_example.roundoff_status: example bound excludes additional descriptor/evaluator/output errors

claims.title: Arbitrary-degree damped causal mixed-moment phi formula
claims.guarantee: The causal integral of (t-s)^r s^d exp(-a*s) has finite phi/confluent divided-difference representation DW10 and the correct beta limit at a=0; positive integral form supports absolute enclosures without time Taylor resolving kappa*T.
premises: nonnegative integers r,d
validated scalar exponential/interval evaluation for implementation
limits: native scalar_phi_enclosure low-degree support is not arbitrary mixed-moment support
alternating expanded formula alone is not stable floating code

claims.title: All-mode error including inherited initial errors and arithmetic
claims.guarantee: DW11 mean and DW12 per-mode bounds include inherited component errors, detuning tail, damped nonlinear kernel tail, transformed candidate residual and separately charged descriptor/phase/output errors.
premises: whole-window transformed candidate |uhat|<=B
true transformed mean within same B
candidate residual bound is for exact descriptor bound to computed initial vector
fixed declared parameters or separately charged parameter uncertainty
all initial amplitudes and phases retained
limits: candidate mean and weighted mean of final reconstructed modes need not coincide; residual pays the discrepancy
no global guarantee for candidates outside the certified tube

claims.title: Certified multiwindow transport by diagonal plus rank-one error operators
claims.guarantee: DW13-DW15 propagate all initial and local errors in O(n) work per window; P^2=P permits exact closed product for fixed weights. If kappa>=3|chi|R_n^2, norm amplification is <=1 and length-weighted local budgets close the finite-horizon global budget.
premises: R_n encloses both exact reference-start norms
fixed normalized weights for closed product
each local eta is computed with zero inherited error and includes all local arithmetic
previous component error vector retained at restart
actual accepted grid and target identity bound
limits: the transfer matrix is an error upper-bound operator, not exact nonlinear Jacobian
single-trajectory energy decay alone does not imply nonexpansivity

claims.title: Same-map compilation with strict total-work sufficient condition
claims.guarantee: Common-damping mode aggregation commutes with every homotopy coefficient step; fixed dense coefficient schedule reduces kernel contraction count n(p+1)M_f to (p+1)M_f. Under Cconv>Cio and n>(Cconv+Cfixed)/(Cconv-Cio), all separately charged extra work is overcome.
premises: same homotopy/discrete map and representation for comparator
nonlinear forcing generated once on both sides
common phi table costs treated symmetrically
actual upper/lower counted costs include setup, certificate, output, failures and fallback
accuracy premises DW-B/D also hold
limits: not against an already hoisted comparator
not wall-clock or universal bit complexity
dense zero slots cannot be charged to sparse skipping comparator

output_cost_contract.forcing_representation: formed once; exponent <=3Q and time degree <=3D
output_cost_contract.shared_algebra_each_output: O((p+1)(Q+1)(D+1)^2), charged at every output time
output_cost_contract.special_function_cost: preprocessing plus sum over all output times, separate from ordinary shared algebra
output_cost_contract.strict_gate: C_io and C_fixed include costs for all requested outputs
output_cost_contract.zero_order_case: plus-one factors preserve constant forcing/output costs at p=0 or Q=0
